| MTP3 + capture + vocab + verify fold | 28.52 | 23.77 | 24.39 |
| MTP2 + capture + vocab + fold + 4-bit KV | 30.29 | 25.29 | 21.56 |

The fastest configuration is **MTP2 + capture + 32k-vocab draft head**, which achieves 30.75 tok/s on short prompts.<|im_end|>
